authorDisposition: Both findings are technically confirmed and remain OPEN. This author record does not close either finding or authorize Stage 8 GO.

findings.rootCause: WorkerStats are placed in structured worker_cycle logs and private health.json, but no fixed-name metrics exposition/export interface exists. Stage 8 observability contract requires low-cardinality essential metrics and private/operator-only diagnostics without a public listener.
findings.plannedCorrection: Add a small Prometheus text exposition for the required worker snapshot values with fixed metric names and no dynamic labels, and publish it only in the worker's private runtime directory. No public listener, new runtime service, vendor SDK, generic event platform, or Stage 9 surface.
findings.adversarialProof: Test every required metric name/type/value, no customer/principal/Trip labels, null/unavailable snapshot behavior, and atomic private-file replacement. Exercise the actual extracted worker runtime path and verify the emitted exposition is current and private.
findings.reproduction: The current code exposes no metrics interface; logs and JSON health status are not a metrics exposition. Confirmed from the exact gen02 source hashes in the independent report.

findings.rootCause: WorkerRepository.ready() checks only a subset of the table/column privileges used by dispatch, claim, attempt recording, completion, and recovery. Revoking an unchecked privilege can leave readiness true while work processing fails.
findings.plannedCorrection: Make readiness fail closed on missing schema USAGE and every worker-required SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE table/column capability for job, attempt, outbox_delivery, activity_source, event_context, and activity.entry, while preserving the worker identity check and explicit denial of sensitive trip/staff reads.
findings.adversarialProof: In the real disposable PostgreSQL Stage 8 suite, revoke each required grant independently, assert ready() returns false, restore it in finally, then prove the normal role still passes and still cannot SELECT protected trip/staff tables or mutate immutable history.
findings.reproduction: Current ready() checks SELECT job, UPDATE job.state, INSERT activity.entry, and SELECT activity_source; SQL paths also use attempt, outbox_delivery, multiple job columns, event_context, and job INSERT. The Stage 8 migration grants these capabilities separately.
